arxiv-2105-05327.title: Physical characteristics of glasma from the earliest stage of relativistic heavy ion collisions
arxiv-2105-05327.creator: Margaret E. Carrington, Alina Czajka, Stanisław Mrówczyński
arxiv-2105-05327.description: Abstract We present some analytic results that describe the gluon field, or glasma, that exists at very early times after a collision of relativistic heavy ions at proper time τ = 0 \tau=0 . We use a Colour Glass Condensate approach, and perform an expansion in τ \tau .

arxiv-2111-04693.title: Precision B ∗ ​ B ​ π B^{*}B\pi coupling from three-flavor lattice QCD
arxiv-2111-04693.description: Abstract We consider three-flavor QCD and perform a determination of the low-energy coupling g ^ χ \hat{g}_{\chi} of SU(2) Heavy Meson Chiral Perturbation Theory. It is the B ∗ ​ B ​ π B^{*}B\pi coupling in the limit of static heavy and chiral light quarks and has not been determined with precision thus far.

arxiv-2112-12143.title: Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentation with Image-Level Labels
arxiv-2112-12143.creator: Golnaz Ghiasi, Xiuye Gu, Yin Cui, Tsung-Yi Lin
arxiv-2112-12143.description: Abstract We design an open-vocabulary image segmentation model to organize an image into meaningful regions indicated by arbitrary texts. Recent works (CLIP and ALIGN), despite attaining impressive open-vocabulary classification accuracy with image-level caption labels, are unable to segment visual concepts with pixels.

arxiv-2212-12016.title: Novel Bottomonium Results
arxiv-2212-12016.creator: Seyong Kim
arxiv-2212-12016.description: Abstract We present the latest results from the use of the Backus-Gilbert method for reconstructing the spectra of NRQCD bottomonium mesons using anisotropic FASTSUM ensembles at non-zero temperature. We focus in particular on results from the η b \eta_{b} , Υ \Upsilon , χ b ​ 1 \chi_{b1} and h b h_{b} generated from Tikhonov-regularized Backus-Gilbert coefficient sets.

arxiv-2306-00196.title: Restless Bandits with Average Reward: Breaking the Uniform Global Attractor Assumption
arxiv-2306-00196.creator: Yige Hong, Qiaomin Xie, Yudong Chen, Weina Wang
arxiv-2306-00196.description: Abstract We study the infinite-horizon restless bandit problem with the average reward criterion, in both discrete-time and continuous-time settings. A fundamental goal is to efficiently compute policies that achieve a diminishing optimality gap as the number of arms, N N , grows large.

arxiv-2404-10057.title: Universal distributions of overlaps from generic dynamics in quantum many-body systems
arxiv-2404-10057.creator: Alexios Christopoulos, Amos Chan †, Andrea De Luca ††
arxiv-2404-10057.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexios Christopoulos, Amos Chan †, Andrea De Luca ††. We study the distribution of overlaps with the computational basis of a quantum state generated under generic quantum many-body chaotic dynamics, without conserved quantities, for a finite time t t . We argue that, scaling time logarithmically with the system size t ∝ log ⁡ L t\propto\log L , the overlap distribution converges to a universal form in the thermodynamic limit, forming a one-parameter family that generalizes the celebrated Porter-Thomas distribution.

arxiv-2409-03175.title: Data-based approaches to learning and control by similarity between heterogeneous systems
arxiv-2409-03175.creator: Chenchao Wang, Deyuan Meng
arxiv-2409-03175.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chenchao Wang, Deyuan Meng. This paper proposes basic definitions of similarity and similarity indexes between admissible behaviors of heterogeneous host and guest systems and further presents a similarity-based learning control framework by exploiting the offline sampled data. By exploring helpful geometric properties of the admissible behavior and decomposing it into the subspace and offset components, the similarity indexes between two admissible behaviors are defined as the principal angles between their corresponding subspace components.

arxiv-2510-17300.title: Counterexamples to the conjecture of the upper bound of the derivative of a rational Bézier curve Journal: Nuclear Physics B
arxiv-2510-17300.creator: Mao Shi
arxiv-2510-17300.description: Abstract In this paper, we present counterexamples to the upper bound of the first-order derivative of rational Bézier curves, as proposed by Li et al. in Applied Mathematics and Computation 219 (2013) 10425-10433, and further investigate the supremum of derivatives of all orders for such curves.

arxiv-2601-23092.title: WiFiPenTester: Advancing Wireless Ethical Hacking with Governed GenAI
arxiv-2601-23092.creator: Haitham S. Al-Sinani, Chris J. Mitchell
arxiv-2601-23092.description: Abstract Wireless ethical hacking relies heavily on skilled practitioners manually interpreting reconnaissance results and executing complex, time-sensitive sequences of commands to identify vulnerable targets, capture authentication handshakes, and assess password resilience; a process that is inherently labour-intensive, difficult to scale, and prone to subjective judgement and human error.

plaw-111-19-2009.title: Civil Rights History Project Act of 2009
plaw-111-19-2009.creator: United States Congress
plaw-111-19-2009.description: Public Law 111-19 (2009): Civil Rights History Project Act of 2009

pmc-10611715.title: Regional and interhemispheric differences of neuronal representations in dentate gyrus and CA3 inferred from expression of zif268
pmc-10611715.creator: Lars-Patrick Schmill, Katharina Bohle, Niels Röhrdanz, Thomas Schiffelholz, Kira Balueva, Peer Wulff
pmc-10611715.description: The hippocampal formation is one of the best studied brain regions for spatial and mnemonic representations. These representations have been reported to differ in their properties for individual hippocampal subregions. One approach that allows the detection of neuronal representations is immediate early gene imaging, which relies on the visualization of genomic responses of activated neuronal populations, so called engrams.

pmc-10631216.title: Performance of synacthen test in chronic hemodialysis patients
pmc-10631216.creator: Manuela Nickler, Susanne Stampf, Luca Bernasconi, Stephan Segerer, Claudine A Blum, Min Jeong Kim
pmc-10631216.description: BackgroundAdrenal function tests (Synacthen test) in chronic hemodialysis (HD) patients are currently performed off dialysis. The study aimed to demonstrate equivalence of serum cortisol concentrations pre- and during HD, each for standard-dose (250 µg) and low-dose (1 µg) Synacthen test.

pmc-11339283.title: Strong and weak alignment of large language models with human values
pmc-11339283.creator: Mehdi Khamassi, Marceau Nahon, Raja Chatila
pmc-11339283.description: Minimizing negative impacts of Artificial Intelligent (AI) systems on human societies without human supervision requires them to be able to align with human values. However, most current work only addresses this issue from a technical point of view, e.g., improving current methods relying on reinforcement learning from human feedback, neglecting what it means and is required for alignment to occur.

pmc-11599269.title: Retraction Note: Anti-aging effect of transplanted amniotic membrane mesenchymal stem cells in a premature aging model of Bmi-1 deficiency
pmc-11599269.creator: Chunfeng Xie, Jianliang Jin, Xianhui Lv, Jianguo Tao, Rong Wang, Dengshun Miao
pmc-11599269.description: ecifically, the image panel for lung tissue in condition Bmi-1+β-gal AMSCs in Figure 8e appears to overlap with the Figure 8f images for lung tissue in WT and Bmi-1+β-gal AMSCs conditions. Concerns were also raised about missing background features due to overexposure of several blots in Figure 5, and differential contrast adjustments made to blots presented in Figure 6.

pmc-12420247.title: Early-life undernutrition, immune dysregulation, and cancer incidence in later life: a national life-course analysis from the China health and retirement longitudinal study
pmc-12420247.creator: Hailin Wang, Changkang Wu, Xuancheng Zhou, Gang Huang, Jingdong Li, Xiaowei Tang
pmc-12420247.description: BackgroundSevere childhood famine may imprint durable immunometabolic scars, yet its longitudinal impact on chronic inflammation and cancer trajectories in China’s ageing population is unresolved.MethodsWe analyzed 2–515 adults in the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (2011–2015) who were born 1947–1961; early-life undernutrition was assigned when birth occurred during 1959–1961 and in one of five provinces with > 30% grain deficit.

pmc-12608009.title: F41, a Novel Fungal Indole-Diterpenoid, Overcomes Gemcitabine Resistance in Pancreatic Cancer by Inducing ER Stress
pmc-12608009.creator: Zixiang Gao, Li Liu, Yang Xu, Cong Zhao, Xiaojun Zhao, Ting Zhao, Yongsheng Che, Wuli Zhao
pmc-12608009.description: Pancreatic cancer is an aggressive malignancy with a poor prognosis. It is characterized by low surgical resection rates, frequent development of chemoresistance, unsatisfactory treatment outcomes, and a high potential for recurrence and metastasis. Compound F41, a naturally occurring indole-diterpenoid secondary metabolite, was isolated from the entomopathogenic fungus Penicillium sp. Its anti-pancreatic cancer activity has not been previously reported.

pmc-12641990.title: Improving patients’ satisfaction through service digitalization: a cross-sectional study based on the theory of psychological empowerment
pmc-12641990.creator: Guan-shuang Zhou, Sheng-hui Shi, Qian-rui Qian, Qiu-ying Zheng
pmc-12641990.description: BackgroundThe digital transformation of medical services promotes innovation in medical services, changes service models, optimizes medical processes, improves service quality, and ultimately enhances patient experience and satisfaction. This study aims to explore the relationship between digital transformation of medical services and patient satisfaction.MethodA cross-sectional online-based survey was conducted with 348 respondents in January and February 2023.

pmc-12661457.title: Global trends and inequalities in hypertensive and ischemic heart disease attributable to high body mass index: A systematic analysis from 1990 to 2021 with projections to 2035
pmc-12661457.creator: Xinyu Liu, Xu Zhang, Cheng Li
pmc-12661457.description: BackgroundHypertensive heart disease (HHD) and ischemic heart disease (IHD) are major global burdens. High body mass index (BMI) is a key modifiable risk factor, but the global burden, trends, and inequalities of HHD and IHD attributable to high BMI remain poorly defined.

pmc-13011949.title: N6-methyladenosine-modified miR-873 promotes receptor-interacting protein kinase 3-mediated necroptosis after intracerebral hemorrhage in mice and HT22 cells
pmc-13011949.creator: Jianfei Wang, Shuoyang Wang, Xiaodong Wu, Bin Lu, Jingfeng Huang, Dijing Yu, Shoucai Zhao, Zhaohu Chu, Yingshui Yao, Yang Xu
pmc-13011949.description: BackgroundIntracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) causes a severe form of stroke characterized by high morbidity, mortality, and long-term disability. Neuronal cell death is influenced at the posttranscriptional level. Certain microRNAs influence neuronal cell death at the posttranscriptional level by regulating receptor-interacting protein kinase 3 (RIPK3), a key mediator of necroptosis.

pmc-13094898.title: The personal habits and sleep quality affect the health-related quality of patients with hypertension: The results of a cross-sectional study
pmc-13094898.creator: Betcy George, Porkodi Arjunan, Abraham M. Ittyachen, Rajkumar Mani, Soney M. Varghese, Ramesh Chandrababu
pmc-13094898.description: BACKGROUND:Hypertension can negatively impact the quality of life and may influence sleep patterns. While traditional cardiovascular risk factors are well-established, the potential of irregular sleep patterns as a novel risk factor for heart disease is still not well understood. The objectives were to assess the prevalence of hypertension and its correlation with sleep habits and overall quality of life.

pmc-13211657.title: Changing Patterns of HCV Genotype Distribution in a Migration-Affected Region of Turkey: A Retrospective Hospital-Based Study (2014–2021)
pmc-13211657.creator: Yasemin Ay Altintop, Esma Saatçi
pmc-13211657.description: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection is still a major worldwide health concern. It is distinguished by a high degree of genetic variation that affects the course of the illness and the effectiveness of treatment. The epidemiological profile of HCV is prone to rapid change in areas where there is significant human migration, like Turkey.

pmc-13225517.title: Lipid-lowering drugs and essential hemorrhagic thrombocythemia’s risk: A drug-target Mendelian randomization study
pmc-13225517.creator: Peng Zhang, HaiJiao Wang, MingHao Lin, Peng Dai, Qi Zhong, RuoLin Wang, Lei Sheng, Ze He, Zheng Nan
pmc-13225517.description: Lipid-lowering drugs are currently widely used by clinicians in clinical practice; numerous related studies have confirmed the pivotal role of the lipid pathway in regulating platelet function. Lipid-lowering drugs, represented by statins, have been found to have an improving effect on platelet-related diseases.

pmc-13373849.title: Combined phylogenetic and geographic data can predict plant–pest interactions with high accuracy
pmc-13373849.creator: Elvira Hernández‐Gutiérrez, Richard A. Nichols, Laura J. Kelly
pmc-13373849.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Summary Non‐native plant pests can pose major threats to biodiversity, with destructive ecological and economic consequences.
